description: The camera faces the Duomo head-on from the center of Piazza del Duomo. Floodlit spires and pinnacles crowd the Gothic façade in the middle of the frame, with the gilded Madonnina glinting at the very top. Arcaded palazzi line the square to the left and right, their windows glowing warm. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 05:02 Europe/Rome: full night, the cathedral artificially lit against a black sky.
